# VibeLang repository

Before writing or reviewing a `.vibe` file, read packages/compiler/skills/vibelang/SKILL.md (4,713 tokens): every form beside the Effect code it replaces, the rules with their EK codes, and the idiomatic choice for each job. The full docs are https://vibelang.sh/llms.txt.

Specification: `docs/design/src/`. Process: CONTRIBUTING.md.

- Work on one accepted issue. Add a test that fails without your change; compiler semantics get a case in `typescript/vibelang/cases/`.
- Run `sh scripts/e2e.sh` for install, compiler, runtime or starter changes. Report exact results, including failures and checks you couldn't run.
- VibeLang ships no quick fixes or codemods of its own before its first release. TypeScript's built-in code fixes remain available.
- A file that says it is generated changes only through its source.
- Match nearby code, format Go with gofmt, and don't reformat unrelated code.
- Never put credentials or private user content in fixtures, logs or issues.
- Follow the [Uphill rules](.agents/uphill/rules.md), which `uphill rules --write` rewrites from each metric's description: @.agents/uphill/rules.md
- Agents never approve or merge.

## vibe and main

Work happens on `vibe`, and `main` is the productionized version. Treat `vibe` as one never-ending stacked PR:

1. Land work on `vibe` right away. A red `vibe` is normal and blocks nobody.
2. Take the first commit on `vibe`, or rebase so the commit you want is first, and make it green by amending it in place.
3. Rebase the rest of `vibe` onto it, and meanwhile land the green commit on `main`.
4. Repeat for the next commit on `vibe`.

`main` only moves forward, to green commits, and is never rewritten. Base new work on `vibe`. Build toolchains from `main` unless you need a commit that's only on `vibe`, and say so when you do.

## Coding factory, MCP, wiki, and backpressure

- Follow `.smithers/instructions/mcp-agent.md` for authenticated MCP access (issues, PRs, TODOs, docs, flows) and one-time-use sandbox credentials via `bun .smithers/scripts/mint-sandbox-auth.ts` (mode-600 files only, never on argv).
- Project `.smithers/FACTORY.ts` via `bun .smithers/scripts/project-factory.ts --write` and verify the `//.smithers:factory-suite` targets.
- Read and maintain the Obsidian-compatible repository wiki and Mythical History in `docs/wiki/` (`bun .smithers/scripts/wiki.ts --check`).
- Run `bun scripts/audit/run-audit.ts` to generate the Lighthouse-style backpressure audit report. Untrusted runs use read-only remote cache hits and never publish trunk cache entries or skip gates.
